Author: @panduispog
Content: It's worth dumping some stock or even water or whatever liquid in the pan when mushrooms first go in. Mushrooms have a tendency to just mop up oil if you don't boil out the water first, and paradoxically, adding even a small amount of water helps the mushrooms release theirs. It's a thermal conductivity thing. The water creates steam, the steam makes contact with the water inside the mushrooms, said water gets heated more efficiently than a "dry" mushroom, said mushroom then releases it's water.
